actions.description: Read metadata, status, and safe summaries for an ontology object.
Update non-computational metadata such as name, description, tag, status note, or owner.
actions.rollback: Reapply the prior metadata snapshot from the audit event.

actions.description: Register a validated process graph version for later simulation input generation.
actions.rollback: Register a superseding version; do not mutate historical graph evidence.

actions.description: Attach a water quality sample to a monitoring point.
actions.rollback: Mark the sample superseded or invalid; preserve the original observation record.

actions.description: Record a material inventory balance entry.
actions.rollback: Post a compensating balance adjustment with an audit reason.

actions.description: Create an operational or maintenance work order for an equipment asset.
actions.rollback: Cancel the work order with a reason; do not delete its audit trail.

actions.description: Close a work order after validation or maintenance completion.
actions.rollback: Reopen the work order with a new audit event if allowed by operating policy.

actions.description: Record completed maintenance, corrective action, or inspection evidence.
actions.rollback: Append a correction event rather than mutating the original event.

actions.description: Queue a compute job from a process graph, benchmark case, agent draft, or approved request.
actions.rollback: Cancel a queued job before worker claim; completed results stay immutable evidence.

actions.description: Register or update a governed model version entry.
Advance a parameter set lifecycle after required validation or benchmark evidence is available.
actions.rollback: Retire the parameter set or promote a superseding candidate; do not erase historical promotion evidence.

actions.description: Publish an evidence package for external review or production-readiness handoff.
actions.rollback: Publish a superseding evidence package with an explicit correction reason.

actions.description: Acknowledge a risk finding without deleting the underlying blocker or warning evidence.
actions.rollback: Reopen or supersede the risk finding with a follow-up audit event.

actions.description: Approve a confirmed agent draft before promotion to a process graph or compute request.
actions.rollback: Reject a later draft version or create a superseding confirmation; do not mutate the original confirmation.
